sentences.en: My software never has bugs. It just has random features.
sentences.zh: 我的软件从来没有bug。它只是有一些随机的功能。

sentences.en: We shall fix all bugs today before leaving the office.
sentences.zh: 我们今天离开办公室前要把所有的bug都修复好。

sentences.en: The programmers could not find the cause of the bug.
sentences.zh: 程序员们找不到这个bug的原因。
